experiment: Offline sweep of persistence-based append-only target commit policies.

methodology.append_only: Committed target text is never retracted.
methodology.candidate_prefix: Longest common prefix of the last N target drafts.
methodology.hold: The final M tokens of the stable prefix remain uncommitted.
methodology.strict_safe_pre_final_coverage: Pre-final target coverage is counted only for strict-safe sequences; unsafe sequences contribute zero.
methodology.strict_safety: No future target draft may contradict already committed text, and the final target must be completable append-only.
